title: GA4GH AI Registry: skill entry (v1)
description: The common entry core plus an embedded SKILL.md-style frontmatter object and the fields Project #24 specifies as required for a certifiable skill: defined inputs, outputs, provenance logging, human oversight requirements, and evaluation criteria (internal project documentation Section 3.5.3, internal project documentation Section 6.4). source.repository is shaped to match agentregistry's Skill kind so a future integration is a mapping exercise, not a schema rework; its url is any externally hosted git repository, not limited to a GA4GH-controlled host.

skill.description: Embedded SKILL.md-style frontmatter. Ecosystem-specific frontmatter fields beyond name/description are preserved as-is (additionalProperties intentionally open, mirroring Claude Code's own tolerance of unrecognised SKILL.md frontmatter keys).

url.description: Source repository for the skill, on any git hosting service (GitHub, GitLab, self-hosted, or other).

subfolder.description: Optional relative path from the repository root to the skill, for a skill living in a monorepo or a nested package structure.

inputs.description: Defined inputs the skill accepts, per Project #24's certification requirements.

outputs.description: Defined outputs the skill produces, per Project #24's certification requirements.

evaluation_criteria_uri.description: Pointer to the skill's evaluation criteria document.

host_runtimes.description: Coding harnesses or runtimes this skill has been verified to run under.
